name: @bryance/orch
description: Fleet orchestration control plane for various coding afent harness's and multiplexers for optimal coding agent orchestration and control from any provider.

scripts.fallow:accept: bunx fallow dupes --save-baseline .fallow-dupes-baseline.json && bunx fallow health --save-baseline .fallow-health-baseline.json
scripts.check:all: bun run --parallel --no-exit-on-error lint tc check:bridge lint:web tc:web
scripts.build: bun run build:cli && bun run build:web
scripts.build:cli: bun run retire-daemon && bun run build:ext && bun run build:bin && bun run build:daemon && bun run build:hooks && bun run build:notify
scripts.build:ext: bun run build:ext:pi && bun run build:ext:omp
scripts.build:bin: bun build bin/orch.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile dist/bin/orch.js && bun scripts/build-bin.ts
scripts.install:global: bun run build:cli && tarball=$(npm pack --silent) && npm install -g "./$tarball" && rm -f "$tarball"
scripts.build:dev: bun run install:global && orch doctor -y && orch daemon start
scripts.lint: oxlint bin src test extensions scripts
scripts.reinstall: bun scripts/reset.ts && bun run install:global && orch setup && orch doctor -y && orch daemon start

author: Bryan Edman
